plugins.name: assistant-worker
plugins.description: An assistant you talk to, one worker session per thread of work (in tmux it starts and checks on them itself), and a browser agent that keeps Playwright out of everyone's context.

plugins.name: fineline
plugins.description: Fineline status line: thin hairline bars, branch and model on top; context and 5-hour and 7-day limits below.

plugins.name: skyline
plugins.description: Skyline: a token usage chart that goes below your existing status line, not in place of it. One bar per message, showing tokens per call.

plugins.name: conventional-commits
plugins.description: Conventional Commits for Claude and git: tells Claude the rule every session, and /conventional-commits:setup adds a commit-msg hook that rejects messages in the wrong format.

plugins.name: quietlint
plugins.description: Lints and type checks the files Claude edited when its turn ends, using your repo's own tools, and stays silent unless there are problems. /quietlint:setup detects your tools and adds format and lint to pre-commit.

plugins.name: clear-me-now
plugins.description: Say "I'm gonna clear you" and Claude writes a handoff document, you type /clear (in tmux, Claude clears itself), and the fresh session reads it and carries on. Claude pushes back if it's in the middle of something.
